subject: widget/key-custody
summary: Private keys and derived secrets are confined to the crypto Web Worker (WASM/ArrayBuffer memory, shortest practical lifetime); the UI thread receives only public keys, signed events, and ciphertext — framed as surface minimization, not an absolute boundary, since a worker is not a security boundary against malicious same-origin code.

subject: protocol/rollback-detection
summary: Generation rollback against the device's local high-water mark fails closed by default (RollbackDetectedError) on login and password change, with an explicit acknowledgeRollback override for a merely lagging relay; a brand-new device with no high-water mark retains only the quorum defense.

subject: distribution/vendored-widget
summary: No CDN or npm release: consuming sites vendor the built widget into their own origin so no single compromised deploy can hit every integrator at once and every update passes a per-site review step; integration-visible changes are therefore recorded in CHANGELOG.md.
